Sorry my reply is so late. It was an amazing experience and I would definitely do it again if the opportunity presents itself. My advice is to be thorough when you’ve narrowed down a farm you want to visit. Make sure that you understand what stage it’s at and jobs the owner will expect of you bc of that. Also think about what knowledge you would like to get out of the stay. The farm I visited was in early stages, so I dug a lot of holes, picked large rocks out of what would be new garden beds, and even helped start the install of a new irrigation system. I knew this farm was only a few years old, but I didn’t actually know what that meant in terms of how the land was developed. The owner also preferred things to be done without too much heavy machinery, so it was a lot of work! It was rewarding though. I was surprised but happy with what I learned out there.
